links.outcome: LLM-estimated ISS agreement with human-assigned ISS on local retrospective data
links.effect: Weighted Kappa 0.91 (Grok-3), 0.88 (GPT-4), 0.54 (Perplexity); ICC 0.97 GPT-4, 0.92 Grok-3, 0.84 Perplexity; LoA ±5.2, ±7.0, ±9.7.
links.quote: Categorical agreement was high in Grok-3 (weighted Kappa = 0.91), and GPT-4 (weighted Kappa = 0.88), but adequate in Perplexity (weighted Keppa = 0.54).

links.outcome: Comparison of three candidate LLMs against human-assigned ISS on the same data
links.effect: GPT-4 and Grok-3 showed high agreement (weighted Kappa 0.88, 0.91) while Perplexity was lower (0.54); ICCs 0.97, 0.92, 0.84.
links.quote: ICCs were 0.97 (GPT-4, CI 95% = 0.94–0.98), 0.92 (Grok-3, CI 95% = 0.86–0.95), and 0.84 (Perplexity, CI 95% = 0.73–0.91), demonstrating near-expert-level consistency.

unlisted_practices: Iterative prompt engineering to refine LLM prompts for trauma scoring

screen.reason: Retrospective validation of LLMs (GPT-4, Grok-3, Perplexity) for automated Injury Severity Score (ISS) calculation compared to human-assigned scores.
